modern_conflicting_name_use.citation: J. Liu and J. Zhang, A Common Generalization to Theorems on Set Systems with L-intersections, arXiv:1707.01715v1 (2017), Theorem 1.3
modern_conflicting_name_use.claim: For an L-intersecting family of arbitrary subsets of [n], with |L|=s, the bound is sum_{i=0}^s choose(n,i).
modern_conflicting_name_use.assessment: This materially different result is also explicitly named the Frankl-Wilson theorem and cites the same 1981 paper; it confirms that the sparse catalog gloss does not select the modular uniform abstract result by itself. The modular theorem is not dismissed as its corollary: residue classes may contain many actual intersection sizes and the single-binomial modular bound differs from the sum bound.
